scope: Compact Weber find-verify-fix audit method packet adapted from the SGA5 live source-audit workflow. This belongs on the workflow/replication record, not as a promoted Weber reader.
observed_contents: WEBER_AUDIT_METHOD_AND_PLAN.md explaining the SGA5 find-verify-fix method and its Weber-specific adaptation, including the 2026-06-25 priority correction: German transcription/source completeness first; English translation later.

WEBER_CERT_LOG.md recording Band I p100-p143 source-verified audit work: p100/p102 determinant/proof/formula repairs, p106 theorem numeral restoration, p108-p113 sign-schema/equation/tag/figure repairs, p114-p119 roots-of-unity/xref repairs, p120-p125 Greek/Latin variable repairs, p126-p131 dense convergence-proof repairs, p132-p137 rejected false candidates, p138-p143 symmetric-function/Newton-footnote/equation repairs, clean-page receipts, rejected phantom proposals, and 357-358 page/0-error compile gates.
WEBER_METHOD_LOG.md recording the measured find-verify-fix loop, p100-p143 token/run metrics, no-scan/confirm-absence prompt adjustments, verifier-failure observations, and current cursor after p143.
weber_audit_workflow.js runnable workflow prompt/script for Weber German transcription-vs-scan auditing.
chunk_page.py, measure_sources.py, and build_manifest.py helper scripts.
audit_manifest.json, the compact three-volume page/offset/control manifest.
workflow_lessons: The SGA5 page-local find -> verify -> fix pattern transfers to Weber German transcription, but Weber immediate priority is omission/summarization detection in the German branch, not English translation.
The current Weber German TeX is a half-baked GPT draft and must be audited for missing lines, compressed prose, and missing formulae before fine symbol forensics.

The logged Weber passes now cover p100-p143. They restored determinant/proof/formula material, theorem numerals, source equation tags, sign-schema labels, roots-of-unity symbols, xrefs, single-symbol Greek/Latin variable confusions, dense convergence-proof notation, dropped equations, Newton footnote material, and symmetric-function displays while preserving 357-358 page/0-error compile gates.

Verifier quality is inconsistent: it rejected all four p105 phantom proposals in one batch but accepted all eight p108-p113 candidates in another, leaving the foreground source-eye check as the real gate.
The same workflow can produce hallucinated fixes on phantom/no-scan pages, proving again that agent output must be treated as finder evidence and never applied without source-image verification.

The current dominant Weber Volume I error pattern after p114 is single-glyph mathematical misreading (epsilon/xi, d/delta, gamma/y) rather than large prose drops; these are cheap for agents to find and easy to eye-verify but mathematically material.

Local source measurement found no native >=650dpi Weber scan on disk: Band I and III are about 500dpi and Band II about 560dpi, so tight crops and explicit uncertainty flags are required for hard symbols.
The workflow separates type A source deviations from type B source typos and cosmetic differences.
Every accepted fix still requires foreground/human review before application; the agent output is patch-ready evidence, not authority.
One workflow at a time is safer than many concurrent workflows because the limiting factor observed in SGA5/Weber lanes is server/tool reliability and rate limiting rather than local CPU/GPU.
The packet deliberately excludes bulky rendered source chunks; those should be generated on demand from the manifest.

A later p132-p137 batch showed the verifier can pass all candidates that the foreground eye rejects, including a false escalation of Weber double-bar <= glyphs to three-way inequalities and a source-typo xref reversion. The foreground source-eye gate remains mandatory.
caveats: This package does not certify Weber and should not be attached to the Weber author record as a reader replacement.
The included audit manifest is a control/harness layer; it is not a proof that all pages have been audited.
next_action: Attach the refreshed 9-file Weber method/cert-log snapshot to the workflow/replication record during the next deliberate workflow DOI refresh, alongside the SGA5 find-verify-fix method snapshot.
